shapes.title: Phirna Root (MM7)
shapes.identity: Dark green-brown thin branching root, two gnarled rootlets and a curved lance-shaped green leaf at the upper end. Irregular natural root, never humanoid.

shapes.title: Phirna Root (MM8)
shapes.identity: Blue mandrake-like root with a tiny pointed crown, knotted torso, two long forked root legs and thin branching arm rootlets. Preserve the strange humanoid root silhouette, not a creature.

shapes.title: Phima Root (MM6)
shapes.identity: Dark blue-grey bulbous knobbly root with a long curling narrow rootlet rising at one end and shorter twisted rootlets at the base.

shapes.title: Wealthy Hat
shapes.identity: Brown broad-brimmed felt hat, rounded crown, a narrow gold band and one large curved magenta-pink feather. Empty hat with real depth.

shapes.title: Season's Stole
shapes.identity: Red silk stole with a gathered loose central fold and two short hanging tails with thin gold fringed edges. A soft folded cloth resting on the ground, not a cape.

shapes.title: Heart of the Wood
shapes.identity: Short tapered translucent violet-white crystal relic, set into a gold circular flanged socket at its wide end; thin gold prongs along crystal edges. Preserve the short cylindrical crystal and ornate gold mounting.

shapes.title: Dragon Claw
shapes.identity: Orange scaled short cylindrical dragon-claw relic or handle, gold stepped circular cap at one end, narrow curved ivory talon at the opposite end; small orange raised scale lobes. Not an entire dragon hand.

shapes.title: Spider Queen's Heart
shapes.identity: Dark blood-red anatomical heart with asymmetrical muscular lobes, surface veins, short severed vessels at the broad top, tapered rounded lower end. No gore scene or other organs.

shapes.title: Naga Hide
shapes.identity: Long narrow flattened orange-brown snakeskin hide, scalloped edges, round dark rimmed scales on both flanks and pale transverse belly plates in one continuous central stripe. Thick pliable skin with shallow natural folds, not armor.

shapes.title: Dire Wolf Pelt
shapes.identity: Grey-brown furry wolf pelt laid flat with splayed four leg stubs, broad shoulder end, tapered rear and long thin tail. Furred hide only, no live wolf or skull.

shapes.title: Pirate Hat
shapes.identity: Black tricorn pirate hat with raised curved sides, narrow red edging, small ivory skull and crossed bones centred on the front. Hollow hat with depth, no head inside.

shapes.title: Ogre Ear
shapes.identity: Single large tan-brown severed pointed ear, curled thick outer helix, inner antihelix and deep concha, soft fleshy lobe taper at the bottom. No earrings or extra anatomy.

shapes.title: Leather Pouch / Bat Guano
shapes.identity: Golden tan rounded rectangular leather shoulder pouch with arched flap, a brass U-shaped clasp and long narrow leather strap loosely around it. Visible creased leather panels and stitched edges.

shapes.title: Leather Pouch with Teeth
shapes.identity: Dark brown soft leather tapered pouch with a red cord around its upper rim and four distinct long ivory tooth pendants hanging from small gold loops along the top front. Preserve all four teeth.

shapes.title: Quilted Leather Pouch
shapes.identity: Golden brown rectangular leather pouch with drawstring gathered rim, front flap and silver diamond-shaped buckle, a loose narrow looped side strap, diamond quilting on the lower front.

shapes.title: Whisp wrappings
shapes.identity: Low irregular flattened bundle of ochre-brown ragged cloth strips, folded and loosely wound across one another, frayed pointed ends. Keep the thin soft layered outline; no human remains or mummy.
